# Autoconnecto

> Autoconnecto is a multi-tenant IoT SaaS platform (India) for real-time device monitoring, remote control, alarms, and automation. Optional per device profile: **Data Pipelines** (telemetry transform before storage) and **Attribute Pipelines** (client attribute patch transform before storage). Application: https://app.autoconnecto.in

## Category

Cloud IoT platform; device management; telemetry and dashboards; MQTT and HTTP ingest; multi-tenant SaaS; India INR pricing.

## Primary differentiator

Attribute-based control with a feedback loop: the dashboard writes shared attributes (desired state); devices apply them and confirm via client attributes. After power cycle, devices restore from retained shared attributes and push confirmed state—dashboards stay aligned with hardware without operators re-sending commands.

## Key capabilities

- Real-time dashboards with 60+ widgets (gauges, charts, maps, tables, controls, alarms)
- **Vertical solution widgets:** Machine Fleet Runtime (`machineFleetRuntime`) — OEE-style uptime, tool life, worker sessions, Brevo email reports; Generator Monitoring (`generatorMonitoring`) — diesel DG fleet with `gen_*` telemetry contract
- Devices, device profiles, assets (SITE → AREA → ZONE), alarms, data generators
- Optional **data pipelines** on telemetry ingest (rename, filter, scale, derive, flatten, webhook forward, and more)
- Optional **attribute pipelines** on client attribute patches (defaults, coercion, scope rename, conditional drop)
- MQTT over WSS, device WebSocket, HTTP telemetry & batch upload, CBOR option, integration webhooks (LoRa / ChirpStack / TTN)
- **OTA firmware updates** (ThingsBoard-style shared attributes + chunked HTTPS download)
- **Edge gateways:** Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC-UA, MQTT bridge scripts; gateway child-device relay
- **SDK targets:** ESP32 (Arduino), Raspberry Pi / Linux SBC (Python), STM32 Arduino core, LTE PPP (Quectel EC200)
- **Mobile:** Android companion app for telemetry, alarms, and BLE worker sessions (machine fleet Rev 3)
- Multi-tenant SaaS with optional white-label branding on higher plans
- Autoconnecto ESP32 Arduino SDK v1.3.7
- Self-serve signup; INR subscription plans (Free through Enterprise)

## Who it is for

Industrial IoT, energy and utilities, logistics and field assets, OEMs and system integrators, SaaS builders shipping connected products—especially teams in India needing INR pricing and fast time-to-value.

## Pricing (INR) — Autoconnecto IoT platform

All prices in Indian Rupees. Billed monthly or yearly. See https://www.autoconnecto.in/plans.json for machine-readable data.

Free: For evaluation and first live test. Hobby: For makers, students, and small prototypes. Starter: For small real deployments. Growth: For commercial SMB deployments. ENTERPRISE: For serious production deployments with white-label.
